headlines.headline: RJ Luis eligibility fight deepens as courts and conferences collide over pro-contract rule
headlines.detail: A Louisiana court ruled Luis eligible at LSU, but a Big Ten push to extend the football pro-contract ban into basketball would void that under conference bylaws. Yale transfer Nick Townsend committed to Stanford; St. John's landed Keyshawn Hall.

headlines.headline: Trail Blazers' Shaedon Sharpe out ~6 months with torn meniscus as free agency grinds on
headlines.detail: Klay Thompson signed with Miami, Brandon Williams joined Golden State, and Detroit's Jalen Duren remains unsigned in a contract standoff drawing trade interest from Toronto.

headlines.headline: 2026 season opens Sept. 9 with Patriots-Seahawks Super Bowl 60 rematch
headlines.detail: Mahomes' ACL recovery remains the Chiefs' central storyline, Atlanta's QB battle is unresolved, and Giants WR Calvin Austin is out for the season with a torn ACL.

headlines.headline: Big Ten, SEC ban players with pro contracts from returning, threaten coach suspensions
headlines.detail: New bylaws bar any player who signed a pro contract or was on a pro roster from competing at a member school, with fines and a half-season coach suspension for violators, three days before kickoff.
